b.x: 01 If water enters the house, go to the highest floor with folder, water, meds, and light.
02 Breaker off if it is safe to reach. Do not step in a pool with a wire.
03 Do not drive the flooded road. Thirty centimeters will take a car.
04 Do not drink, do not let a child play, do not swim ‘a short stretch’.
05 Signal. Wait for rescue if current has already cut the street.
